suggestions.title: The Godfather
suggestions.description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his reluctant youngest son, Michael, in this legendary mafia saga filled with unforgettable performances from Marlon Brando and Al Pacino. A sweeping masterpiece of power, loyalty, and family.

suggestions.title: Spirited Away
suggestions.description: Young Chihiro enters a magical world of spirits and must work in a bathhouse to rescue her transformed parents. Hayao Miyazaki's Oscar-winning masterpiece of imagination, courage, and coming-of-age wonder.

suggestions.title: Pulp Fiction
suggestions.description: Interweaving stories of a hitman, his partner, a boxer, and a pair of diner bandits collide in Quentin Tarantino's genre-defying, non-linear masterpiece that redefined modern cinema.
